segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I talked with Northline this morning. They're good with the 48 seats, but they want the renewal to start February 1 instead of January 15.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay, that should be fine. Same package as current, or are they adding the reporting add-on?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Same package, plus 6 contractor seats for their ops team. Total comes to $38,400 for the year before tax.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Did they push on the uplift?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: A little. I held at 4%, and they didn't fight it much. Their main thing is getting the invoice split quarterly, because finance doesn't want the full annual in February.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Quarterly billing needs approval if it's under 50 grand. Did you send it through deal desk?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, I spent most of yesterday getting the renewal packet together. I had to enter the 48 seats, February 1 start, quarterly billing, and the $38,400 total in the CRM, then the billing tool, then the deal desk form, then again in the proposal template before legal would look at it.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. If legal is only reviewing billing terms, that should come back today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's what I'm hoping. Customer asked for signature by Friday, January 12, so they can keep the go-live for the contractor seats on February 5.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Once legal clears it, send me the final PDF before you send to them. I just want to check the term dates and invoice language.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll ping you when it lands back in my queue.
